verses.text: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. We write to all God's holy people in Christ Jesus at Philippi, and to the church leaders and helpers.
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
I thank my God every time I remember you.
Whenever I pray for all of you, I always pray with joy,
because you have shared with me in spreading the Good News, from the first day until now.
I am sure of this. God began a good work in you, and he will carry it on until it is finished on the day of Christ Jesus.
It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, because you are in my heart. Whether I am in chains or defending the Good News and proving it true, you all share in God's grace with me.
God knows how much I long for all of you, with the tender love of Christ Jesus.
This is my prayer. I pray that your love will grow more and more, with knowledge and good judgement.
Then you will be able to choose what is best. You will be pure and without blame for the day of Christ.
You will be filled with the good fruit of being right with God, which comes through Jesus Christ. This brings glory and praise to God.
Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that what has happened to me has actually helped the Good News to spread.
The whole palace guard and everyone else here know that I am in chains for Christ.
And because I am in chains, most of the believers have become more confident in the Lord. They dare to speak God's word more boldly and without fear.
It is true that some preach Christ because they are jealous and want to fight. But others preach him with good hearts.
The first group preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not honestly. They think they can add to my troubles while I am in chains.
The others do it out of love. They know that God has put me here to defend the Good News.
But what does it matter? What matters is that Christ is preached in every way, whether for wrong reasons or true ones. I am glad about that. Yes, and I will keep on being glad,
because I know that this will turn out for my good. It will happen through your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ.
I eagerly hope that I will not be ashamed in any way. I hope to be very bold, so that now as always Christ will be honoured in my body, whether I live or die.
For me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
If I go on living in this body, it will mean fruitful work for me. Yet I do not know which to choose.
I am torn between the two. I long to leave this life and be with Christ, which is far better.
But it is more important for you that I stay in the body.
Since I am sure of this, I know that I will stay. I will stay with all of you, to help you grow and have joy in the faith.
Then when I come to you again, you will have even more reason to boast in Christ Jesus because of me.

Whatever happens, live in a way that is worthy of the Good News of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you, I will know this. You stand firm in one spirit, fighting side by side, with one mind, for the faith of the Good News.
Do not be frightened in any way by those who are against you. This is a sign to them that they will be destroyed, but that you will be saved, and that by God.
God has given you the gift, for Christ's sake, not only of believing in him but also of suffering for him.
You are going through the same struggle you saw me have, and now hear that I still have.
